title: A novel liquid flow electrochromic smart window for all-year-round dynamic photothermal regulation
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,1824-1834
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05416D, Paper
Ya Huang, Shuangdui Wu, Siming Zhao, Zhenyu Guo, Zhuojing Zhao, Xueke Wu, Baoshun Wang, Fei Wang, Aike Xi, Fan Lan, Yunrui Li, Jiaqi Xu, Run Li, Yanlong Zhao, Rufan Zhang
A novel liquid flow electrochromic smart window was developed, capable of significantly reducing building energy consumption in most climate zones around the world.
